hook_line: H-1B ATTACK TARGETED COMPANIES, NOT HOLDERS

hook_stat.sub: Vance says his H-1B criticism was of employers and the visa system, not visa holders

stats.label: of approved H-1B petitions annually are accounted for by Indian professionals
CBS News town hall where Vance conceded his rhetoric had been imperfect
Vance announced no new policy and did not retract his support for tighter controls

diaspora_bullets: Vance invoked his in-laws, who immigrated from South India
His in-laws' daughter, born in the United States, is now the second lady
news_summary: At a CBS News town hall in Flat Rock, Michigan, Vice President JD Vance said his 'foreign indentured servants' description was a criticism of companies and the visa system, not of H-1B holders, and conceded his rhetoric had been imperfect.
payoff: No rule changed: H-1B status and PERM positions are unchanged, and the clarification does not restore any suspended firm's PERM access.
